figurative_meaning_en: To exhibit extreme stinginess or miserliness
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই কৃপণ যে হাতে জল না গলা, কাউকে কিছু দিতে চায় না।
এই ব্যবসায়ী হাতে জল না গলা, সবসময় খরচ কমানোর চেষ্টা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so stingy that water wouldn't melt in his hands; he refuses to give anything to anyone.
This businessman is tight-fisted, always trying to cut costs wherever possible.
note: This idiom vividly portrays extreme reluctance to part with money or resources, rooted in everyday Bengali observations of human behavior.
